files.description: The complete EHI export documentation for HealUs EHR v1.0. A 6-page PDF (5 content pages + 1 blank) describing the 170.315(b)(10) export capability. Covers export formats (C-CDA, FHIR, CSV, PDF), export workflow instructions, and data categories included in the export. No data dictionary or field-level definitions. Created 2024-04-22.

FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement from the HealUs FHIR server. Identifies 28 supported resource types (standard US Core set). Relevant because the EHI PDF claims FHIR is one of the export mechanisms. Shows the FHIR export covers only standard US Core resources with no custom/vendor-specific extensions.

Screenshot of the HealUs EHR Knowledge Hub showing the EHI documentation page. The Angular SPA renders the EHI.pdf in an embedded PDF viewer with a sidebar navigation showing All APIs, Security, Data Export, and Predictive DSIs sections.
